refusalReason.description: Sanitized plugin apply refusal; never contains configuration values or secret references.

SkinListResult.description: Selectable skins derived from the enabled, trusted package inventory.

css.description: Stylesheet text, sent with the roster so a skin that ships no assets needs no second request. Omitted when the stylesheet exceeds the install cap, in which case the client falls back to cssUrl.

shadowed.description: Skin ids rejected because an earlier package already declared them.

primaryStatus.description: Read-only primary plugin status. Underlying desired, trust, actual and generation facts keep their existing meanings; readiness never means a tool is executing.

current.description: Whether this generation is a current head of a non-retired session composition; independent of activation success.

title.description: The session's title, when it has one.

run.description: Whether a turn is in progress. A session that is not open is idle.

blocked.description: Durable pin or head records that cannot be read. Generation collection removes nothing while any is listed.

file.description: Path of the damaged record relative to the profile directory.

expectedHash.description: Required for repository local-plugin trust; binds confirmation to the offered package and hooks snapshot.

SkinReadParams.description: One same-origin skin route path to read bytes for. The path is a URL path, never a filesystem path.

SkinReadResult.description: Bytes for one skin asset, or a negative answer. A miss and a refusal are indistinguishable on purpose.

base64.description: Standard base64 of the file, bounded by the install-time cap for the file class.

ClientModuleListResult.description: Web client module roster for one profile. `rows` is the row-level browser projection (rowId/moduleName/enabled/phase plus optional asset metadata); it never carries runtime row config, credentials, or artifact data. The legacy modules/statuses arrays remain during the compatibility window so older callers can continue reading ready assets and package status.

revision.description: Opaque roster revision; changes whenever the roster content changes. Unrelated to package integrity.

rows.description: Row-level projection for browser consumers. It carries only an explicit manifest publicConfig allow-list; runtime row config, credentials, secret references and opaque artifact fields are not permitted.

rowAliases.description: Persisted legacy browser row migrations. Each old row id maps to exactly one current canonical row id.

rowId.description: Stable browser lifecycle row id. Omitted only by legacy producers; packageId remains the authorization subject.

revision.description: Integrity of the installed revision this entry serves.

slotCatalogVersion.description: Exact browser component-slot catalog version used by this contribution. Missing only for legacy Agnes slots.

contentDigest.description: Digest of the verified immutable browser snapshot manifest. Missing only for legacy producers.

extIds.description: Backend extension ids activated by this package; the page uses them for slot-fill claim matching.

publicConfig.description: Explicitly public package-authored browser metadata. It is immutable manifest data, never runtime row config, credentials, secret references or artifact data.

backendRevision.description: Revision the backend extensions actually run at; null for pure-frontend packages or when unknown.

reason.description: Fixed-enum reason text; never leaks internal paths.

retained.description: Superseded snapshots still served during their grace window.

ClientModuleRosterRow.description: Safe browser projection of one runtime client row. Asset metadata is optional for non-ready phases. publicConfig is immutable manifest metadata; runtime config, credentials and secret references are intentionally absent.

rowId.description: Stable browser row id, normally web:<package-id>.

moduleName.description: Safe display/lookup name for the browser module; never a credential or config key.

packageId.description: Installed package that owns this row. It is an identifier only, never a credential or configuration value.

enabled.description: Whether the row is enabled by the currently selected runtime projection.

phase.description: Safe lifecycle phase; this is not a worker convergence report and does not expose internal failure text.

revision.description: Immutable client asset revision when one is available.

slotCatalogVersion.description: Exact browser component-slot catalog version used by this row. Missing only for legacy Agnes slots.

contentDigest.description: Digest of the verified immutable browser snapshot manifest. Missing only for legacy producers.

extIds.description: Backend extension ids associated with the row; these are identifiers only, never extension configuration.

streams.description: Immutable same-owner stream allowlist; current activation and exact snapshot are also required.

services.description: Immutable manifest-declared same-extension query service names. This projection is a browser UX/API allow-list, never a credential or arbitrary RPC route.

publicConfig.description: Explicitly public package-authored client configuration. It is a narrow manifest projection, never runtime row config, credentials, secret references or artifact data.

presentationRoleBindings.description: Host-verified per-role consent binding for this exact client declaration, package identity and dependency closure; never supplied by plugin code.

ClientModuleReadParams.description: One same-origin client-module route path to read bytes for. The path is a URL path, never a filesystem path.

ClientModuleReadResult.description: Bytes for one client-module file, or a negative answer. A miss and a refusal are indistinguishable on purpose.

base64.description: Standard base64 of the file, bounded by the resource install-time cap (32 MiB raw). Code files retain their separate 4 MiB install-time cap.

ClientModuleServiceCallParams.description: Private launcher-to-daemon request for one ready browser row's declared query service. Browser identity, extension identity and credentials are deliberately not parameters.

ClientModuleServiceCallResult.description: Sanitized result of a declared query service. The daemon verifies the service output schema before it reaches this private relay.

ClientModuleEffectCallParams.description: Private launcher-to-daemon request for one explicitly authorized effect command owned by a ready browser row. Identity and credentials are supplied by the server, never by browser input.

ClientModuleEffectCallResult.description: Sanitized result of an authorized effect service, protected by daemon journal and serialization semantics.

PluginTreeArtifact.description: Canonical RuntimeTarget artifact accepted by plugins.tree.apply. Same envelope as worker RuntimeTargetArtifact.

mode.description: Defaults to replace. Merge retains untouched files and applies explicit removals.

remove.description: Existing paths to delete; valid only with mode merge.

PackagePresentation.description: Read-only display data derived from the installed public author contract; it grants no capabilities.

optional.description: True for a shipped package the user chose to install: it is not part of the product and can be uninstalled.

includes.description: Static package facts without executing plugin code. provides combines author labels with explicit contribution evidence, independently of runtime registrations. A count is present only when the package data states it; an absent count means the number is decided in code, not zero.

presets.description: What each bundle preset's policy guarantees, derived from package data without running plugin code. Unknown means the answer is decided in code.
